name: 52a-route-entity2
description: A train/bus route may name a second departure entity (ha-paper#22): `entity2`, a sensor.* id; its departures follow the first entity's.
input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: t
    app: travel
    widgets:
      - {type: route, label: Bus 12, mode: bus, entity: sensor.bus_stop_12345678_current_departure_time, entity2: sensor.bus_stop_12345678_next_departure_time, cs: 2}
